theorems.name: Submission.fiw_ims_overlap_finite
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (M : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)) (θ : ℕ → Eucl P → ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℤ), (∀ r, M r ⊆ U) → (∀ r, NullMeasurableSet (M r) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ r, ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn (θ r) (M r ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ r, ∀ x ∈ M r, 1 ≤ θ r x) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * ∫⁻ x in M r ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ r x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (∫⁻ x in K, ∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * (M r).indicator (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (θ r y)) x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) < ∞) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)), {r | c r ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ M r}.Finite
